title: R1c — the test ports as group dispatchers

keeps.check: Build the worktree engine (go build -o <tmp>/bootstrap ./cmd/bootstrap in cli/). In a new scratch git repo, run env -u MISE_PROJECT_ROOT BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG=/nonexistent <tmp>/bootstrap init --no-tui --yes --clone <worktree>, then mise trust, then mise run test, mise run test:e2e and mise run test:golden, then <tmp>/bootstrap describe --json --clone <worktree>. Then add an executable part .config/mise/tasks/test/golden/10-echo that prints its arguments, and run mise run test:golden --update 'a b'.
keeps.pass: Each of the first three mise runs exits 0 and prints the no-part line. describe reports test, test:e2e and test:golden with present true. The 10-echo part prints --update and a b as two arguments (D24).

keeps.check: Copy the main checkout of this repo, with its .git, to a temp folder. Run env -u MISE_PROJECT_ROOT BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG=/nonexistent <tmp>/bootstrap init --no-tui --yes --clone <worktree> in the copy; if it stops on a question, give each answer with --answer, the value the old .config/bootstrap.toml holds. Then run mise tasks ls in the copy.
keeps.pass: .config/mise/tasks/test/50-local holds the old test/_default of this repo; test/_default is the new dispatcher; mise tasks ls still lists test:go, test:repo, test:mac and test:macos-tools, and lists test:50-local.

release_levels.reason: Breaking: own_tasks skips a part with no NN- name, and init moves a repo's own test, test/_default, test/e2e or test/golden file into a 50-local part. New behaviour: the test, test:e2e and test:golden ports. All of it goes into the one bootstrap@4.0.0 tag (R1b D16).

units.title: Review: the dispatchers, the init move and the tests

shared_files.why: U1 and U2 falsify the task tables and the init text

decisions.decision: Which of the 14 ports of R1b D3 does R1c make exist?
decisions.ruling: Non-R2 ports only (Recommended): R1c makes test, test:e2e and test:golden exist. R2 makes git:merge:<branch>, git:worktree:create|setup|delete and code:lsp:check with real work. code:format, code:lint, code:sec, code:precommit and setup already exist in every shaped repo through the required base tools (mise, pre-commit, gitleaks, grype, osv-scanner), and do not change. No release comes between R1c and R2 (R1b D16).
decisions.rejected: All 14 ports, with git:* and code:lsp:check as no-ops or wrappers that R2 replaces.

decisions.decision: The shape of test, test:e2e and test:golden.
decisions.ruling: Group dispatchers (Recommended): the mise tool ships test/_default, test/e2e/_default and test/golden/_default, each a dispatcher that loops own_tasks, as code:format does. A tool or the repo adds NN-<name> parts. With no part, a dispatcher prints one line and exits 0.
decisions.rejected: #PLACEHOLDER files that a stack replaces at the same path.

decisions.decision: Does mise run test also run test:e2e and test:golden?
decisions.ruling: No, parts only (Recommended): test runs only its own NN- parts; test:e2e and test:golden each run by name.

decisions.decision: stackgen packs copy test/e2e and test/golden as files, where the D2 dispatchers need folders.
decisions.ruling: Dispatchers; packs ship parts (Recommended): own_tasks takes only executable files whose name matches NN-<name>, and skips folders. init moves a stray test/e2e or test/golden file (not in the manifest) to test/e2e/50-local or test/golden/50-local. check and sync report a file that the manifest does not list at a dispatcher path with code 2 and the fix line → Run bootstrap init. A claude-plugins plan changes the packs to ship NN- parts (parked).
decisions.rejected: A sync mode that writes a default only when no file exists; packs own test:e2e and test:golden.

decisions.decision: The patterned port p:<id>:deploy: bootstrap knows no project ids.
decisions.ruling: Nothing in R1c (Recommended): R1c ships no p:<id>:deploy. A patterned port has no default; it exists for an id only when a task for that id exists, which R1b's describe reports. An amendment of the design record's rule that every port exists in every shaped repo; U5 records it. Per-project ids in bootstrap go with R5.
decisions.rejected: A dispatcher per project id from repo.toml.

decisions.decision: What does R1c require?
decisions.ruling: R1a and R1b (Recommended): R1c runs on R1b's code, so no two plans edit cli/ at once, and K1 can run describe. Priority 70 (10 + 60, the R1b row).

decisions.decision: A repo can already have its own test task (a test file or a test/_default the manifest does not list), as this repo does.
decisions.ruling: Move it to a part (Recommended): init moves the repo's own test file or test/_default to test/50-local, then writes the dispatcher; mise run test runs it as a part, and its depends and task names do not change. check and sync report it with code 2 and → Run bootstrap init until then. In this repo the move happens when the user runs bootstrap init after 4.0.0.
decisions.rejected: Keep the repo's own task and skip the dispatcher.

decisions.decision: The target <group>/50-local already exists.
decisions.ruling: Stated by the planner, confirmed at the shape gate: init stops with code 2 and names both paths.

decisions.decision: Does this change plan need a review unit?
decisions.ruling: Yes, one, after the tests: the plan lands engine Go code and task scripts that run in every shaped repo.

decisions.decision: The execution mode.
decisions.ruling: teams: wave 1 holds two edit units (U1 and U2).

decisions.decision: New dependencies.
decisions.ruling: None.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 1: a repo's own test/e2e/_default or test/golden/_default that the manifest does not list.
decisions.ruling: The init table has six paths: it also moves a repo's own test/e2e/_default and test/golden/_default to <group>/50-local, by the D7 rule.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 2: member flags and arguments of the test dispatchers.
decisions.ruling: The same as code-format.tmpl: the same member flags (--all, --<member>), and the arguments and flags go to each part.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 3: a repo's own test task in mise.toml [tasks.test] or in another task folder.
decisions.ruling: Out of scope for the move. docs/sync/migrate.md gets one line: move such a task by hand into .config/mise/tasks/test/50-local.
decisions.rejected: init moves it; check reports it.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 4: a repo's own part without an NN- name stops running in code:format, code:lint, code:sec, setup:deps, setup:secrets and the test ports.
decisions.ruling: check reports each executable file without an NN- name in a dispatcher folder (code/format, code/lint, code/sec, setup/deps, setup/secrets, test, test/e2e, test/golden) as a warning (code 0), with the fix rename it to NN-<name>. docs/sync/migrate.md gets a rename item.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 5: D2 (a dispatcher with no part prints one line) against docs/design/mise.md:637 (a task that does not apply prints nothing).
decisions.ruling: D2 holds for dispatchers, as code:format already prints a success line with no parts. U5 amends the rule at mise.md:637: a task script that does not apply prints nothing; a dispatcher with no part prints one line.

decisions.decision: Round 1 gap 6: docs/memory/handoff/bootstrap-plugins-split.md contradicts D1, D2 and D5.
decisions.ruling: Out of scope: the handoff is a session record that the next /vwf:handoff replaces (as R1b D36).
decisions.rejected: Widen U5 owns to the handoff.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 1: after the move, this repo's test/go, mac, macos-tools and repo have no NN- name but run through the depends of test/50-local.
decisions.ruling: A file whose task name the #MISE depends of another file in the same folder names is not a part, and gets no D15 warning.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 2: the #USAGE of the test dispatchers, and what reaches a part.
decisions.ruling: They declare the member flags of code-format.tmpl and no other flag, plus one variadic argument, which goes unchanged to each part. A part with no #USAGE gets the arguments as plain positional arguments.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 3: one table entry hits an existing 50-local while another must move.
decisions.ruling: init examines every entry first; if any target exists, it stops with code 2 before it moves a file (D8).
decisions.rejected: Move some files, then restore them.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 4: how the bash case makes an unlisted test/_default, and check on a never-shaped repo.
decisions.ruling: The case uses an unshaped scratch repo: a git repo with its own test/_default and a stray test/e2e, and no .config/bootstrap/. check exits 2 by R1a's rule for a missing folder (→ Run bootstrap init); init then moves the files.

decisions.decision: Round 2 gap 5: the citation of the rule A task that does not apply prints nothing.
decisions.ruling: It is at about docs/design/mise.md:638.

decisions.decision: Who ships the test parts of a stack after R5 (stack without packs)?
decisions.ruling: Not decided in R1c. User asked for a parked record: docs/memory/gaps/2026-11-14-r5-test-parts-owner-parked.md. R1c rules only the dispatchers (bootstrap) and the 50-local move.

decisions.decision: Round 3 gap 1: can a part's own flag (for example --update of a golden part) reach the part through a dispatcher that declares only the member flags and one variadic argument?
decisions.ruling: Yes, verified on mise 2026.11.7: mise run t --update a and mise run t -- --update a both put --update a into the variadic argument, and a declared --all is parsed as a flag. The dispatcher passes the raw arguments to each part unchanged, after it removes the member flags; it does not use the joined usage_args string, which loses the quoting of an argument with spaces. K1 checks that mise run test:golden --update gives --update to a part.
decisions.rejected: Declare part flags in the dispatcher; require --; call the part directly.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 1: how init shows the 50-local move in its change list and in the TUI.
decisions.ruling: One change, labelled move own test tasks into 50-local parts; its detail lists each file and its target. It cannot be removed alone, because without the move check and sync give code 2; to decline it, decline the init run. The same pattern as R1a's one folder-migration change.
decisions.rejected: One change per file; a change the user can remove alone.

decisions.decision: Round 4 gap 2: a file at a table path with bootstrap's Synced from bootstrap header that the manifest does not list (a lost manifest entry).
decisions.ruling: Such a file is bootstrap's own: init and sync overwrite it with the new dispatcher and do not move it, and check gives no code 2 for it. Only a file without that header is the repo's own and moves. This prevents a moved dispatcher that loops own_tasks test again.
